intended_behavior: Implement a new Mem0 class or extend LanceDBMemory to provide the methods add, query, evict, and mem_consolidation. These methods will enable advanced long-term memory retention with support for structured content, extended metadata injection, conditional eviction, and memory consolidation for performance improvements, preserving existing memory functionalities.

Extend the integrate function to add support for Mem0 integration. Prompt users optionally to provide their own Mem0 API tokens; if not provided, use the default community token. Store the token information in the integration config similarly to other platforms to enable Mem0 features in the user workflow without disrupting existing integrations.
